description.zh: 查询监控数据的时间区间的截止时间（UTC），默认值是当前。
description.en: The end time of the time range to query monitoring data. The time is displayed in UTC. The default value is the current time.

description.zh: 任务ID。您可以调用[ListJobs](~~459676~~)获取所有任务的ID。
description.en: The job ID. You can call [ListJobs](~~459676~~) to query all job IDs.

description.zh:
查询监控数据的指标类型，取值如下：

- GpuCoreUsage：GPU使用率。

- GpuMemoryUsage：GPU Memory使用率。

- CpuCoreUsage：CPU使用率。

- MemoryUsage：Memory使用率。

- NetworkInputRate：网络写入速率。

- NetworkOutputRate：网络写出速率。

- DiskReadRate：磁盘读取速率。

- DiskWriteRate：磁盘写入速率。
description.en:
The type of the monitoring metrics. Valid values:

*   GpuCoreUsage: GPU utilization
*   GpuMemoryUsage: GPU memory utilization
*   CpuCoreUsage: CPU utilization
*   MemoryUsage: memory utilization
*   NetworkInputRate: the network write in rate.
*   NetworkOutputRate: the network write out rate
*   DiskReadRate: the disk read rate
*   DiskWriteRate: the disk write rate

description.zh: 查询监控数据的时间区间的起始时间（UTC），默认值是1小时前。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query monitoring data. The time is displayed in UTC. The default value is the time 1 hour before the current time.

description.zh: 返回监控数据的时间间隔，默认值是5分钟。
description.en: The interval at which monitoring data is returned. Default value: 5. Unit: minutes.
The temporary token used for authentication.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pai-dlc get-job-metrics --job-id dlc-20210126170216-0000000 --start-time 2020-11-08T16:00:00Z --end-time 2020-11-09T16:00:00Z --time-step 5m --metric-type GpuMemoryUsage --token eyXXXX-XXXX.XXXXX --region cn-hangzhou
